annotations.text: Notes — Phase 1: docked bottom drawer + "active note" + quick-capture from anywhere. Chrome matched to the app: #6d28d9 purple, Inter, 16/12/8px radii, token-for-token light + dark (flip the Theme tweak on any artboard). Reading column stays Crimson Pro serif per the brand's "text is Scripture, not chrome" rule.

1 · Drawer docked. Header: active-note title + chevron to the switcher, a refs chip, a quiet Saved state, then list / new / pop-out-to-floating-window / collapse. Body is the plain-text editor (Inter, like today's Verse Tools note field). Footer: tag chips + a context-aware "Attach <current verse>" and a link out to My Library, which stays the archive/search/export surface.
2 · Collapsed = a pill on the bottom-right showing the active note; one click re-opens the drawer. Global "N" shortcut opens it from any view. The verse keeps its existing note badge in the text.

3 · New "Add to note" cell in Verse Tools appends "> 2 Cor 4:18 — <verse text>" to the active note (a running study thread) — distinct from today's "Note", which is still the one-note-per-selection verse annotation. Toast confirms; the launcher shows +1.

4 · Chevron opens the switcher in-place: search, + New note, and a list showing title, snippet, a refs count and last-updated. Picking one makes it the active note. Snippets render citations with the shared linkify hover, per the standing "every reference is previewable" rule.

5 · On mobile the floating-window option is dropped — drawer becomes a bottom sheet over a scrim, drag handle to resize, swipe down to dismiss. 44px hit targets. No fake status bar / keyboard. Sits below the shared tooltip + toast (z 600) per CLAUDE.md.

Not shown (later phases): Phase 2 — pop-out floating draggable/resizable window, position persisted, snap-to-dock. Phase 3 — unified refs model, [[note links]] + backlinks, Write/Preview markdown toggle.
